About Tabebuia Spa & Safari Resort
Welcome to Tabebuia Spa & Safari Resort
A Luxury Wellness and Nature Retreat in Fort Portal, Uganda
​
Tabebuia Spa & Safari Resort is a luxury wellness and safari retreat located on the shores of Lake Nyabikere near Fort Portal, Uganda. Designed as a peaceful eco-luxury destination, the resort offers refined accommodation, holistic wellness experiences, and curated nature encounters in one of Western Uganda's most tranquil settings.
Why Tabebuia Spa & Safari Resort
​
Tabebuia was created as a place of intentional rest, where luxury is defined by calm, space, and thoughtful experiences rather than excess. Every element of the resort is designed to support privacy, stillness, and meaningful connection with nature.
​
From its lakeside setting and eco-conscious design to its personalised service and curated wellness offerings, Tabebuia provides an elevated yet grounded retreat for travellers seeking balance, restoration, and authenticity.
Our Location in Fort Portal, Western Uganda
​
Located near Fort Portal in Western Uganda, Tabebuia Spa & Safari Resort sits overlooking the peaceful waters of Lake Nyabikere, surrounded by lush landscapes, crater lakes, and rich biodiversity.
The region is known for its cool climate, scenic beauty, and proximity to national parks, making it ideal for wellness travel and nature-led escapes.
Curated Nature & Wildlife Experiences
​
Located near some of Western Uganda's most celebrated natural attractions, Tabebuia Spa & Safari Resort offers guests access to a range of curated nature and wildlife experiences.
These include guided chimpanzee trekking in nearby national parks, crater lake walks, birdwatching, and scenic excursions through Fort Portal's surrounding landscapes.
Experiences are arranged in collaboration with trusted local guides and conservation partners, ensuring they are respectful, well-paced, and aligned with the region's natural environment.
All experiences are optional and can be arranged before arrival or during your stay, allowing guests to balance exploration with rest and wellness.
​
​View Regional Experiences
Our Wellness Philosophy
​
Wellness at Tabebuia is guided by the belief that restoration happens when the body, mind, and environment are in balance. Our approach combines mindful movement, restorative spa therapies, nourishing cuisine, and quiet time in nature.
​
Through individual treatments and guided wellness retreats, guests are invited to slow down, reset, and reconnect in a setting designed to support long-term well-being rather than quick escape.
​
View Spa & Wellness
Sustainability & Local Connection
​
Tabebuia Spa & Safari Resort is committed to responsible hospitality and community connection. The resort integrates eco-conscious practices, works with local suppliers, and draws inspiration from regional materials and craftsmanship.
​
By supporting local communities and operating with care for the surrounding environment, Tabebuia aims to offer a luxury experience that is both thoughtful and sustainable.
​
View Our Commitments
A Calm, Considered Escape
​
Whether visiting for a wellness retreat, romantic escape, or nature-focused stay, Tabebuia Spa & Safari Resort offers a calm, refined experience rooted in place, purpose, and care.

Luxury Safari Lodges & Accommodation in Fort Portal, Uganda | Tabebuia Resort
top of page
Where You'll Stay
Welcome to the enchanting world of Tabebuia, where every stay is a seamless blend of comfort and charm. Nestled in idyllic settings, our accommodations offer a unique retreat that embraces the essence of hospitality.
Each space is thoughtfully curated to provide a tranquil haven, allowing guests to unwind amidst the beauty of their surroundings. Whether you seek a cozy hideaway or a spacious retreat, Tabebuia is dedicated to ensuring an unforgettable experience, where the warmth of our hospitality meets the allure of the destination.
Explore our accommodations and embark on a journey of relaxation and rejuvenation with Tabebuia.
​ ​ Lakeside Lullaby Suites
​
Our Lakeside Lullaby Suites are where luxury embraces tranquility on the water's edge, offering immersive nature views, contemporary decor, and spacious elegance.
Indulge in lakeside-facing beds, private balconies, and enchanting mornings, creating a harmonious retreat where the world's cares drift away with the lake's gentle ripples. Your lakeside sanctuary awaits.
​
View More Details
​​ Whispering Lake Villas
​ ​
Our Whispering Lake Villas are where serenity echoes in every corner. Nestled by tranquil waters, these villas provide contemporary elegance and enchanting views, inviting you to immerse yourself in lakeside luxury.
Experience the essence of tranquility, with private balconies offering a front-row seat to nature's beauty. Your whispered invitation to unwind awaits in every moment at Whispering Lakeside Villa.
​
View More Details
​​ Lakeside Breeze Residences
​ ​
​ Our Lakeside Breeze Residences, are where family retreat meets luxury on the water's edge. Our spacious residences, designed for families of up to six, offer panoramic lake views in a warm, inviting atmosphere.
Generously appointed bedrooms ensure comfort for parents and kids, while private balconies provide personal sanctuaries against breathtaking vistas. Experience a harmonious blend of natural beauty and spacious comfort at Lakeside Breeze Residences
​
View More Details
